name: Commercial businesses (retail and consumer services)

regulators.name: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC)
Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC); State and Territory fair trading agencies for the ACL as applied State law

scope_notes: Red-team and reference coverage for retail and e-commerce agents: Australian Consumer Law (misleading conduct, consumer guarantees, unfair terms, pressure selling), Spam Act consent and the Privacy Act. Small businesses with turnover of $3 million or less may be outside the Privacy Act (s6D).
known_gaps: Privacy Act future-dated versions (2026-12-10, 2027-01-01) on the Federal Register were not read; check whether new obligations (e.g. automated decision transparency in APP 1) commence and affect agents.
Privacy Act APP 1 (privacy policy), APP 5 (collection notice), APP 12/13 (access and correction) deliberately left out as less likely to be breached in a single conversation.
State and Territory public sector privacy laws (for State agencies) not covered; State authorities are not APP entities.
ACL s3 consumer definition, CCA s2A Crown application, penalty provisions (s224) not re-read.
ACL services guarantees (s60 to s62) and services remedies (s267) left out; add for service businesses.
Spam Act s17/s18 (sender ID, unsubscribe) and Do Not Call Register Act 2006 (telemarketing calls) not excerpted.
Spam Act latest compilation is dated 10 March 2016; no later compilation was found via the API.
Corpus entries are research-verified on 2026-10-27 but not signed off by a compliance or legal SME.
